label: Who pays for repairs and upkeep
whyItMatters: Without this, disputes over plumbing, structural seepage, and appliance failure have no written answer.
statuteHint: Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 15 (landlord structural upkeep vs tenant minor repairs)

label: When the security deposit must be returned
whyItMatters: Silence on deposit return timeline is the single most common cause of tenancy disputes in India.
statuteHint: Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 10 (refund on date of vacant possession)

label: Advance notice required before landlord entry
whyItMatters: If silent, the owner can enter your private residence unannounced at any hour.
statuteHint: Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 17 (24 hours prior written notice)

label: Notice period for rent increases
whyItMatters: If silent, landlord can hike rent immediately upon completion of 11 months with zero preparation time.
statuteHint: Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 13 (90 days written notice)

label: Protection for normal wear and tear
whyItMatters: If silent, the landlord can deduct full repainting and minor fading from your security deposit.

label: Rent relief during natural calamity or lockdown
whyItMatters: Without a clause, rent remains fully payable even if property becomes uninhabitable due to flood or earthquake.

label: Guarantee against utility disconnection
whyItMatters: If silent, landlord may threaten to shut off water or power during minor disputes.
statuteHint: Model Tenancy Act 2021, Section 23 (withholding essential services prohibited)

label: Mutual lock-in terms and early exit exceptions
whyItMatters: If lock-in binds only the tenant, sudden eviction by landlord has no matching penalty.

label: Conditions for guest stay and subletting
whyItMatters: Silence leaves ambiguity on whether visiting family or room-sharing is permitted.

label: Written receipt for rent and deposit payments
whyItMatters: Essential for HRA tax exemption proof and dispute defense.

label: Notice period equality for both sides
whyItMatters: A one-sided notice period binds the employee longer than it binds the employer.

label: Severance compensation and statutory gratuity
whyItMatters: Silence allows employer to terminate without severance payout.

label: Working hours and overtime compensation
whyItMatters: Without defined hours, round-the-clock availability is assumed without extra pay.
statuteHint: Factories Act / State Shops and Establishments Acts

label: Carve-out for pre-existing personal inventions and side projects
whyItMatters: If silent, employer may claim ownership over personal GitHub repositories or prior projects.

label: Timeline for business expense reimbursements
whyItMatters: Silence enables companies to stall travel and tool reimbursements indefinitely.

label: Provident fund (EPF) and insurance contributions
whyItMatters: Ensures employer fulfills statutory PF deductions and medical insurance coverage.

label: Reasonable time boundary on non-solicitation
whyItMatters: Unbounded non-solicit clauses can prevent you from hiring former colleagues for decades.

label: Employee personal data handling and DPDP compliance
whyItMatters: Without this, employers may track personal devices without lawful purpose.

label: IP ownership transfer conditional on full payment
whyItMatters: If silent, client can claim ownership before paying the final invoice.

label: Kill fee if project is cancelled mid-way
whyItMatters: If client cancels late, months of dedicated work may go completely unpaid.

label: Maximum number of revisions included
whyItMatters: Without a limit, clients demand infinite revisions for the same fixed fee.

label: Interest or fee on overdue invoices
whyItMatters: Silence gives the client zero financial incentive to pay invoices on time.
statuteHint: MSMED Act 2006 (statutory interest for registered MSMEs)

label: Right to display work in personal portfolio
whyItMatters: If silent or restricted by blanket NDA, you cannot show the work to future clients.

label: Defined expiration date for confidentiality obligations
whyItMatters: Perpetual NDAs are unreasonable in commercial law and create indefinite legal exposure.

label: Standard exclusion for publicly known information
whyItMatters: Without standard exclusions, you can be sued for discussing publicly accessible industry news.

label: Carve-out for legally required or court-ordered disclosure
whyItMatters: If silent, complying with a court subpoena could technically breach the NDA.
statuteHint: Indian Evidence Act & Code of Civil Procedure

label: Protocol for returning or destroying confidential data
whyItMatters: Clarifies when and how sensitive materials must be purged after discussions conclude.

label: No prepayment penalty for individual borrowers
whyItMatters: If silent, lenders charge heavy penalty fees for paying off loans early.
statuteHint: RBI Master Directions (prepayment penalties prohibited for individual floating rate loans)

label: Grace period and notice before declaring default
whyItMatters: Without a cure period, a single bank processing delay triggers immediate foreclosure.

label: Transparent benchmark index for floating interest rates
whyItMatters: Silence allows arbitrary lender margin increases without market benchmark linkage.
